result_text:
The Docket-enabled path in `fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/server/mixins/lifespan.py` now sets up the shared-dependency context. It also captures that context so it is re-applied to every request, as the non-Docket paths already did.

I did not add a test for the scenario in your example (a task-enabled server calling `normal_tool` twice, with the factory running once). I also didn't run the full suite or `prek`. A filtered run (`-k "shared or Shared or task"`) gave 438 passed and 34 xfailed, with no failures.

The context is entered before the Docket and Worker start, so the worker inherits it too. The rest of that block is unchanged apart from being indented one level deeper. The no-`pydocket` and no-task-components paths are untouched, and no public signatures changed.
